follow100Note: Mounjaro and Zepbound together supplied $25.46 of every $100 Lilly took in — two versions of the same drug, tirzepatide. Rows may not add exactly due to rounding.
footerNote: Reported (GAAP) figures throughout; Lilly's non-GAAP net income was $2,249M (EPS $2.49). The release reports figures to one decimal place; they are rounded to whole millions here.
oneTimers: Acquired in-process R&D of $622.6M ($0.62 of EPS), mainly the acquisition of Mablink Biosciences and a collaboration agreement with Beam Therapeutics. Lilly counts IPR&D in both its reported and its non-GAAP figures.

U.S. Mounjaro revenue included a favorable one-time change in estimates for rebates and discounts — reported U.S. Mounjaro sales rose 65% from the third quarter, versus underlying growth of about 30%.
otherDetail: Net other income of $121M — $214.7M of net other income, including net gains on investments in equity securities, partly offset by $93.7M of net interest expense.

segments.name: Mounjaro
segments.note: The diabetes shot (tirzepatide) — revenue rose almost eightfold on strong demand; U.S. sales of $2.11B included a favorable one-time change in rebate and discount estimates.

segments.name: Zepbound
segments.note: The weight-loss shot (tirzepatide), launched in the U.S. in November 2023 — $175.8M in its first partial quarter.

segments.name: All other medicines
segments.note: Everything else — Verzenio ($1,145.4M, +42%), Jardiance ($798.1M, +30%) and Taltz ($784.6M, +11%) grew, while Trulicity fell 14% to $1,669.3M. New Products revenue was $2.49B and Growth Products $5.27B.

takeaways.text: Mounjaro brought in $2,205.6M, up from $279.2M a year ago, and Zepbound — launched in November 2023 — added $175.8M in its first partial quarter. Together the two tirzepatide shots were about a quarter of Lilly's revenue; U.S. revenue rose 39% to $6.46B.
takeaways.title: Mounjaro exploded, Zepbound arrived

takeaways.text: Acquired in-process R&D charges of $622.6M, plus $67.7M of asset impairment, restructuring and other special charges, held reported EPS to $2.42 (non-GAAP $2.49). Even so, operating income rose 30% to $2,387.8M on an 80.9% gross margin.
takeaways.title: Bought-in research weighed on profit

takeaways.text: Lilly guided 2024 revenue to $40.4–41.6B and reported EPS to $11.80–$12.30, with Mounjaro and Zepbound growth hinging on how fast it can expand production capacity.
takeaways.title: 2024 guidance set

verdict: Lilly's revenue rose 28% to $9.4B as Mounjaro jumped to $2.2B from $279M a year ago and Zepbound added $176M in its launch quarter — and even after $623M of bought-in research charges, profit rose 13% to $2.19B.
